segments.label: Proximal Femur
segments.description: Hip & proximal femur fractures (trochanteric, femoral neck, head)

groups.label: Trochanteric area
groups.description: Extra-articular trochanteric fractures. Includes pertrochanteric and intertrochanteric patterns.

variants.label: Pertrochanteric, simple
variants.description: Two-fragment pertrochanteric fracture with intact lateral wall. Relatively stable.

variants.label: Pertrochanteric, multifragmentary
variants.description: Comminuted pertrochanteric with posteromedial fragmentation. Disrupted medial buttress.

variants.label: Intertrochanteric
variants.description: Fracture line crosses both cortices. Reverse oblique or transverse pattern — unstable.

treatments.label: Cephalomedullary nail
treatments.main_indications: A2 and A3 fractures, unstable patterns, high-demand patients. Preferred for most trochanteric fractures with medial comminution or reverse oblique pattern.

treatments.label: Sliding hip screw (DHS)
treatments.main_indications: Stable A1 fractures with intact lateral wall. Controlled collapse and impaction at fracture site.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Non-ambulatory patients with extreme operative risk only. High mortality with conservative management.

groups.label: Femoral neck
groups.description: Intracapsular femoral neck fractures. High risk of avascular necrosis of femoral head.

variants.label: Subcapital, slight displacement
variants.description: Garden I/II — impacted or minimally displaced. Valgus or neutral alignment, good prognosis.

variants.label: Transcervical
variants.description: Fracture through mid-neck, may be displaced. Moderate AVN risk.

variants.label: Subcapital, displaced
variants.description: Garden III/IV — completely displaced. High AVN risk, especially in younger patients.

treatments.label: Cannulated screw fixation
treatments.main_indications: B1 (Garden I/II) in young/active patients. 3 parallel screws in inverted triangle. Bone-preserving, minimally invasive.

treatments.label: Hemiarthroplasty
treatments.main_indications: B3 displaced fracture in elderly, low-demand patients. Faster recovery than screws for displaced neck fractures. No acetabular component.

treatments.label: Total hip arthroplasty (THA)
treatments.main_indications: B3 in active patients with pre-existing hip arthritis, or younger patients with high functional demand. Superior long-term outcomes vs hemiarthroplasty.

groups.label: Femoral head
groups.description: Femoral head fractures (Pipkin). Rare, usually associated with hip dislocation.

variants.label: Pipkin I — inferior to fovea
variants.description: Small fragment below fovea capitis. Usually non-weight-bearing surface.

variants.label: Pipkin II — superior to fovea
variants.description: Fragment superior to fovea involves weight-bearing surface. Worse prognosis.

variants.label: Pipkin III/IV — with neck or acetabular fracture
variants.description: Combined head and neck fracture (III) or head and acetabulum fracture (IV). Most complex.

treatments.label: ORIF femoral head
treatments.main_indications: C2 with large displaced weight-bearing fragment in young patient. Anatomic reduction and internal fixation mandatory.

treatments.label: Fragment excision
treatments.main_indications: C1 with small fragment below fovea in older patients. Fragment removal via arthroscopy or open approach.

segments.label: Femoral Shaft
segments.description: Femoral diaphysis fractures — IMN is gold standard

variants.label: Spiral
variants.description: Spiral fracture with long fracture line. Low-energy mechanism. Stable in axial loading.

variants.label: Oblique (≥30°)
variants.description: Oblique fracture at ≥30°. Variable stability depending on length.

variants.label: Transverse (<30°)
variants.description: Transverse or short oblique. High-energy or stress fracture. Potentially unstable.

treatments.label: Intramedullary nail (IMN)
treatments.main_indications: Gold standard for all femoral shaft fractures. Rapid mobilisation, high union rate, load-sharing. Antegrade nailing preferred for proximal and mid-shaft fractures.

treatments.label: Plate fixation (MIPO/open)
treatments.main_indications: Canal too narrow, periprosthetic, extreme deformity. Bridge plating minimises soft tissue stripping.

treatments.label: External fixation (DCO)
treatments.main_indications: Damage control orthopaedics in haemodynamically unstable polytrauma. Bridge to definitive IMN fixation.

variants.label: Spiral wedge
variants.description: Wedge fragment with spiral configuration. Moderate comminution.

variants.label: Bending wedge
variants.description: Bending wedge fragment, often from direct impact.

variants.label: Fragmented wedge
variants.description: Multiple wedge fragments. Borderline complex fracture.

treatments.label: Intramedullary nail (IMN)
treatments.main_indications: First choice for wedge patterns. Relative stability — nail bridges the zone. Closed technique mandatory for comminuted zone.

treatments.label: Bridge plating (MIPO)
treatments.main_indications: B3 with extensive comminution, canal deformity. Submuscular bridge plate preserves fracture biology.

variants.label: Spiral multifragmentary
variants.description: Multiple spiral fragments along the shaft. High-energy mechanism.

variants.label: Segmental
variants.description: Isolated middle segment — bifocal fracture. Two separate fracture lines.

variants.label: Irregular multifragmentary
variants.description: Highly comminuted, no clear pattern. Severe high-energy injury.

treatments.label: Intramedullary nail (IMN)
treatments.main_indications: All C-type shaft fractures. CLOSED technique essential — never open comminuted zone. Reamed nail for load-sharing and biologic stimulation.

treatments.label: Bridge plating (MIPO)
treatments.main_indications: Nail not feasible (prior TKA/THA, severe canal deformity). Long plate spanning full comminution zone.

segments.label: Distal Femur
segments.description: Supracondylar & condylar fractures — articular involvement increases complexity

variants.label: Simple
variants.description: Two-fragment supracondylar fracture. Often from moderate energy.

variants.label: Wedge
variants.description: Supracondylar with medial or lateral wedge fragment.

variants.label: Multifragmentary
variants.description: Comminuted supracondylar. High-energy mechanism.

treatments.label: Retrograde intramedullary nail
treatments.main_indications: A1–A2 extra-articular supracondylar. Minimally invasive, excellent for osteoporotic bone, allows early mobilisation.

treatments.label: Locking plate (LISS/LCP-DF)
treatments.main_indications: A-type with osteoporotic bone, nail not feasible (TKA, prior hardware). Lateral submuscular plate via MIPO technique.

groups.label: Partial articular
groups.description: Unicondylar fractures — partial articular involvement. Articular reduction is mandatory.

variants.label: Lateral condyle, sagittal
variants.description: Lateral femoral condyle split in sagittal plane.

variants.label: Medial condyle, sagittal
variants.description: Medial femoral condyle split in sagittal plane.

variants.label: Frontal (Hoffa fracture)
variants.description: Coronal-plane condylar fracture. Often missed on AP X-ray, best seen on lateral view.

treatments.label: Lag screw fixation
treatments.main_indications: B1/B2 sagittal unicondylar splits. Anatomic reduction essential. 2–3 cortical lag screws perpendicular to fracture.

treatments.label: Buttress / posterior plate
treatments.main_indications: B3 Hoffa fractures (coronal). Posterior screws with posterior support plate. Anterior-to-posterior screw direction.

groups.label: Complete articular
groups.description: Bicondylar fractures — complete articular dissociation. Most complex distal femur pattern.

variants.label: Articular simple, metaphyseal simple
variants.description: Intercondylar split + simple supracondylar. Two main fragments.

variants.label: Articular simple, metaphyseal multifragmentary
variants.description: Intercondylar split + comminuted supracondylar. High-energy.

variants.label: Articular multifragmentary
variants.description: Comminuted articular surface + metaphysis. Severe injury, often associated with knee ligament damage.

treatments.label: Locking plate (LISS/LCP-DF)
treatments.main_indications: C-type bicondylar. ORIF articular surface first (lag screws for intercondylar split), then lateral bridge plate for metaphysis. Standard approach.

treatments.label: Retrograde nail + intercondylar screws
treatments.main_indications: C1 simple articular pattern: lag screws for articular reconstruction first, then retrograde nail for metaphyseal stabilisation.

treatments.label: Primary total knee arthroplasty
treatments.main_indications: C3 with pre-existing severe knee arthritis in elderly, low-demand patients. Hinged prosthesis as primary fracture management.
